name: meeple-on-board-v1
description: ⭐ R17, THE CLOSED RESOURCE LOOP (Dean, 05/09/2026). Handoff v2's arm let a meeple pay for a build, a Grow or a crate and then sent it to the BOX, and the measurement (docs/meeple-loop-measurement-2026-09-04-v2.md) found that is what killed the loop: meeples left the game 18.27 times a game against 9.44 visits, the median supply in the last third hit 0.0 and the hook collapsed 0.35 to 0.09. This arm changes one thing. A meeple spent as a card is now PLACED ON ANOTHER PLAYER'S NOTICE BOARD, in its own colour's slot, exactly as a visit places one, and the host takes it back on their Collect. It buys the payer NOTHING else: no door action, it is not a visit, and the bonus slot is untouched. The payer chooses a host PER MEEPLE, so one payment may feed several neighbours. Placing onto a slot that already holds a meeple costs one FLAT extra meeple of any colour, which goes to the box and is the only drain left bar the supply cap. Read the hook, the bonus mix four ways, and the pool by round first, then the new line: how many meeples a game are placed as payment rather than spent as a visit, and who receives them. The control is overlays/meeple-as-card-v1.overlay.json, which is the same rules with the box as the destination.
